design.name: tr1um_mixed_counter
design.scope: general analog hard-macro and mixed-signal signoff gates

macro_qualification.rationale: CMC structural views match and the macro DRC/LVS gate passes, but process-qualified analog performance, current envelope, mismatch, and post-layout corners are absent.

ota_handoff.rationale: The handoff explicitly has no finalized matching physical views and has not passed independent DRC/LVS.

m3_rc_scope.rationale: The reusable audit reports frame M3 geometry in OSS_EDGE_SEAL0 with M1/M2/V2 overlap and no routed-DEF M3/V2 route. A reviewed seal/core/net exclusion or coupling bound is still required.

erc_electrical.rationale: The final framed gc-diode-repair13 mixed-signal netlist/GDS passed the contract-aware label/ERC gate with zero hard report items, zero warnings, and zero errors. Exact ERC and label reports are bundled under reports/gc-diode-repair13; central electrical limits and analog qualification remain engineering-only.

antenna.rationale: The repaired final-framed triplet passed with zero framed/post-MDP antenna items and zero OpenROAD net/pin violations. Exact framed and post-MDP outputs are bundled under reports/gc-diode-repair13; the release remains engineering-only while regression mismatches and other qualification blockers remain open.

sta_pvt.rationale: The reusable runner now enforces the stated -40..85 degC operating range, the 25..150 degC RS characterization range, endpoint temperature coverage, and qualified low-temperature RS extrapolation before execution. The model audit finds BSIM3 MOS temperature coefficients, explicit F_RR temperature dependence, but no temper term in F_RS and nominal-only CSIO; the design remains engineering-only without low-temperature evidence, process-qualified slow/fast Liberty, complete analog SDC coverage, and a bundled multi-corner report.

pdn_emir.rationale: The fail-closed contract correctly classifies powered PDN analysis as not applicable to the ground-only CMC leaf. The checker now requires central electrical limits plus measured M1/M2, step, and TC contact current evidence for any powered contract. The required return-path review remains engineering-only because no resistance or current-envelope result is bundled; no EM/IR closure is claimed.

post_layout_sim.rationale: The runner now requires pre_layout or post_layout cases, extracted SPICE for post-layout cases, macro CDL, process models, frame/pad/ESD models, digital abstraction, all declared sweep axes, measured limits, device targets, and non-zero assertion margins. The current manifest has no cases because foundry-qualified analog extraction/models and matching OTA views are absent.

crosstalk.rationale: The reusable checker requires extracted aggressor/victim coupling, victim capacitance, measured peak glitch/settling/delay/functional-error values, and explicit limits. The current contract is intentionally blocked because none of those design-specific coupling results are available.

latchup.rationale: The reusable checker requires well/substrate topology, tap and guard-ring continuity/resistance evidence, injection paths, I/O/ESD interactions, substrate-current assumptions, and numerical limits. The current contract is intentionally blocked because no design-specific latch-up evidence is bundled.

mismatch_overdesign.rationale: The reusable checker requires explicit matching layout strategy, dummies, orientation, symmetric routes, surroundings, guard rings, dimensions, headroom, current density, area, and qualified sigma data or an engineering-only guardband. The current contract is blocked because no design-specific matching inventory or overdesign limits are bundled.

esd.rationale: The reusable checker requires every external pad to declare positive and negative discharge paths, VDD/VSS clamps, body/trigger nets, package assumptions, and schematic/CDL/LVS/GDS/parasitic evidence. The current contract is blocked because no pad-level ESD map or package-qualified limits are bundled.

capacitance.rationale: The reusable checker separates intrinsic MOS, CSIO/F_CSIO, and Poly_cap/CAP recognition and requires area/perimeter plus extracted-versus-expected values over voltage, temperature, and process corners. The active flow contains CSIO/F_CSIO model/LVS sources, but no design-specific value table is bundled; Poly_cap/CAP support must be marked unsupported until independently demonstrated.
